lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\NcwTools\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

places: symfony/deprecation-contracts v3.7.1, in 3rdparty/ of Nextcloud 31 to 33
lines: vendor/ ships 9 packages that the server ships itself in a major of Nextcloud 31 to 33. Both copies define the same classes, and the autoloader that is asked first decides which version runs.
symfony/deprecation-contracts v3.7.1, in 3rdparty/ of Nextcloud 31 to 33
1 use of the private API of the server in 1 file. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.

The app reads and writes its app config in 3 places and registers no config lexicon, which IRegistrationContext::registerConfigLexicon() takes since Nextcloud 31. A lexicon states the type, the default and the sensitivity of each key in one place.
